notes.title: My Married Cousin’s Need For Seed is out now!
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33669860/c2534a67635fd7b29df563b8f7558dba243df916.png[/img]

It’s a new month and you know what that has in common with the lady of our newest release? Fuck if I know, but what I do know, is that she has a need...a need for seed, and you’re the only person who can give it to her!

My Married Cousin’s Need for Seed is out and only you can give them what they want so badly! You’re their only hope to fill them up!

This game features:

[list]
[*] Translated version of the original Japanese Visual Novel
[*] Nodoka is fully voiced with original Japanese dialogue
[*] Original artwork HD upscaled with 16:9 and 4:3 variants
[*] Hours of story content
[*] Audio including music and special effects
[*] Enhanced with character sprite animations
[*] Gallery and Scene selections
[*] 14 scenes of sculpting Nodoka into the perfect sex toy!
[/list]

Purchase during the first week of release and get an additional 20% off!

Now get out there and give your cousin that seed!

Love,
Cherry Kiss Games

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1556190
